title: The Chordal Distance Transform of Geometric Loops and its Persistent Homology
summary: We present an isometry and parametrisation invariant of embeddings of $S^1$ into Euclidean space. We do so by representing the distance between pairs of points on the embedded circle as a function on a Möbius band, the two-point finite subset space of $S^1$. We call this function the chordal distance transform of the embedding. We show that the sublevel set persistent homology of the chordal distance transform satisfies the desired isometry and parametrisation invariance, and is a continuous transform with respect to the Whitney topology on the space of circle embeddings and the bottleneck…
